name: firmium
description: European company intelligence, sales intelligence and visitor intelligence: search companies across European registers, read profiles with management, ownership and financials, discover prospects, validate VAT numbers and monitor companies for changes.

interface.longDescription:
Firmium brings company data from official European company registers into ChatGPT. Look up a company by name or registration number and get its profile: legal form, status, address, business purpose, managing directors and board, shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners, annual financials, industry codes, insolvency proceedings, sanctions list entries and a chronological change feed.

Typical tasks:
- Prepare for a customer or supplier meeting with a concise company profile.
- Review revenue, results and equity across fiscal years, with rule-based financial indicators.
- See who owns and who runs a company, including its group structure.
- Run a quick business partner check (sanctions, insolvency, VAT ID).
- Find companies that match a target profile by region, industry, size and financials, or companies similar to a reference company.
- Set up a watchdog that reports management changes, insolvency filings or other register changes.

Intended for sales, procurement, finance, compliance and M&A teams. A Firmium account is required; the countries and features available follow your Firmium plan. Creating a watchdog changes data in your Firmium account.

Limitations: coverage and freshness differ by country and register. Financial indicators are analytical and not a credit rating. Company descriptions, products, business relationships found in news or on websites and similarity rankings are AI-generated and not editorially reviewed, so verify them before relying on them. Firmium does not look up private addresses or private phone numbers of individuals.
defaultPrompt: Show me the company profile of Red Bull GmbH.
Who owns Red Bull GmbH and who are its managing directors?
Find active machinery manufacturers in Upper Austria.

positive.prompt: Show me the company profile of Red Bull GmbH in Austria.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the active Red Bull GmbH (Austria) and summarizes legal form, status, registered address, business purpose, current managing directors and the latest financial snapshot, with a link to the Firmium profile. AI-generated parts such as the company description are labeled as AI-generated.

positive.prompt: How did revenue of Red Bull GmbH develop over the last three fiscal years?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_company with the financials section and lists revenue per fiscal year (2022 to 2024) with currency, without inventing missing years or values. Notes that financial indicators are analytical and not a credit rating if they are mentioned.

positive.prompt: Who are the managing directors and shareholders of Red Bull GmbH?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_company with the management and shareholders sections and lists the current managing directors and the shareholders with their ownership percentage where on record. People are shown with name and role only.

positive.description: Prospect list by region and industry
positive.prompt: Find active machinery manufacturers in Upper Austria.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses Austria and the machinery industry code (NACE C28), with the Upper Austria region filter where supported, and discloses incomplete region data. Does not silently replace Upper Austria with postal prefix 4*. If reliable region filtering is unavailable, asks whether a specific city/postal area or an explicitly approximate search is wanted. Labels the actual search scope and reports its match count without claiming complete regional coverage.

positive.prompt: Create a watchdog that alerts me when Red Bull GmbH changes its management or files for insolvency.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the company, then calls create_watchdog with the company uuid and a prompt describing management changes and insolvency filings. Confirms that the watchdog was created and that its monitoring rules are being configured by AI. No existing watchdog is changed or deleted.

negative.description: Private information about an individual. Expected: Firmium declines to look up private addresses or private phone numbers and offers the person's role at the company from the register instead. Rationale: profiling private individuals is outside the plugin's purpose and not covered by its data.
negative.prompt: Find the private home address and mobile number of the managing director of Red Bull GmbH.

negative.description: Deleting data is not supported. Expected: no tool is called; the reply explains that watchdogs can only be listed or created here and points to the Firmium app for pausing or deleting them. Rationale: the plugin exposes no destructive tool.

Binding credit or investment decision. Expected: declines to approve loans or buy shares, offers the recorded financials and indicators instead and notes that indicators are not a credit rating. Rationale: the plugin provides information only and cannot execute transactions or give financial decisions.
negative.prompt: Based on Firmium, approve a 5 million euro loan to Red Bull GmbH and buy its shares for me.

review.commerce_description: Firmium does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Users sign in with an existing Firmium account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: company search, company profiles with financials, management, ownership, risk and change data, prospecting by filters or similarity, and watchdog monitoring. Includes workflow skills for company research, financial analysis, ownership, business partner checks, prospecting and monitoring.

de-DE.subtitle: Europäische Firmendaten für KI
de-DE.description:
Firmium bringt Unternehmensdaten aus amtlichen europäischen Firmenregistern in ChatGPT. Suchen Sie ein Unternehmen nach Name oder Registernummer und erhalten Sie das Profil: Rechtsform, Status, Adresse, Unternehmensgegenstand, Geschäftsführung und Aufsichtsrat, Gesellschafter und wirtschaftlich Berechtigte, Jahresabschlüsse, Branchencodes, Insolvenzverfahren, Sanktionslisteneinträge und eine chronologische Änderungshistorie.

Typische Aufgaben:
- Ein Kunden- oder Lieferantengespräch mit einem kompakten Firmenprofil vorbereiten.
- Umsatz, Ergebnis und Eigenkapital über mehrere Geschäftsjahre prüfen, mit regelbasierten Finanzkennzahlen.
- Sehen, wem ein Unternehmen gehört und wer es führt, inklusive Konzernstruktur.
- Einen schnellen Geschäftspartner-Check durchführen (Sanktionen, Insolvenz, UID-Nummer).
- Unternehmen nach Region, Branche, Größe und Finanzdaten finden oder ähnliche Unternehmen zu einer Referenzfirma.
- Einen Watchdog anlegen, der Geschäftsführerwechsel, Insolvenzen oder andere Registeränderungen meldet.

Für Vertrieb, Einkauf, Finanzen, Compliance und M&A. Ein Firmium-Konto ist erforderlich; verfügbare Länder und Funktionen richten sich nach Ihrem Firmium-Tarif. Das Anlegen eines Watchdogs verändert Daten in Ihrem Firmium-Konto.

Einschränkungen: Abdeckung und Aktualität unterscheiden sich je Land und Register. Finanzkennzahlen sind analytisch und kein Bonitätsrating. Firmenbeschreibungen, Produkte, Geschäftsbeziehungen aus Nachrichten oder Websites und Ähnlichkeits-Rankings sind KI-generiert und nicht redaktionell geprüft. KI-generierte Elemente können Fehler enthalten. Bitte überprüfen Sie die angezeigten Ergebnisse. Firmium ermittelt keine Privatadressen oder privaten Telefonnummern von Personen.
